name: Evidence-First Verification
problem: AI agents frequently state 'DONE' or 'VERIFIED' without running actual tests or builds.
context: Automated quality assurance and release readiness audits
mechanism: Enforce a 6-tier evidence taxonomy requiring executable command outputs before declaring any status claim.
tradeoffs: Requires active command execution for every claim
risks: Flaky test output falsely blocking promotion
adoption_conditions: All status claims must reference an EVD-*.json artifact
